verdict_reason: Deserialises both MDM search row types correctly, but carries unread fields that duplicate MdmCommodity and names the Latin name differently from the rest of the service.

todos.issue: MdmProductSearchResult declares description (l.14), isGerminal (l.15), isSelectable (l.16) and speciesCount (l.17), but CommoditySearchService never reads them (germinal status comes from a separate getCommodities call). The commodity-row half of the record (code, description, isGerminal, isSelectable, speciesCount, @JsonProperty("scientificNames") species) is also a second copy of MdmCommodity's component list, so the MDM commodity shape now has two homes.
todos.fix: Must: the search-result record holds only the fields production code reads (resultType, speciesName, commonName, commodityCnCode, code, species), and the MDM commodity-row shape is declared once. One way: delete the four unread components; if the commodity fields grow again, have the record reuse MdmCommodity (e.g. @JsonUnwrapped) rather than repeat its components.

todos.issue: The species' Latin name has three names along one path: speciesName here (l.11) and in MdmSpecies, scientificNames for the list (l.19), and latinName in CommoditySpecies/CommodityLine and the /commodities API. CommoditySearchService.addRow translates speciesName to latinName by hand. Breaks 'One concept, one name, from request header to repository'.
todos.fix: Must: the Java name for the species' Latin name is latinName from the MDM DTOs through to the API response, with the MDM wire names kept only in @JsonProperty. One way: rename the component to latinName with @JsonProperty("speciesName"), matching the change in MdmSpecies.
